recipient: Parent for relay to Averroes; no direct message claimed
scope: Availability semantics only; Averroes remains sole producer
recommendation: Keep backend.availability readiness/credential/activation checks mandatory. Its ready means configured and historically validated, not a fresh connectivity measurement.

Separate connection/protocol evidence from request outcome. A typed valid received JEV response followed by an ordinary local policy refusal does not invalidate global readiness, authorize that policy or retry the request.

Do NOT skip every BudgetRefusal by exception class alone: resolve_policy uses the same class for invalid type/choice/probabilities and low confidence. Existing generic failed_or_uncertain lacks sufficient classification.

Safe narrow recovery uses only the already pinned .68 response and validated protocol/custody metadata, with a derived separate health fact or explicit new receipt. Do not rewrite old status, journal or fabricate selected.

A newer network/auth/unknown/protocol failure must not be hidden by scanning back to an older selected route; preserve fail-closed distinctions. In-flight started is neutral. Require matching endpoint/model/config-generation for reused connection evidence.
New requests keep all consent/wallet/capability/contract checks. Do not label a historical HTTP200 as live-health guarantee; HTTP200 alone without valid expected protocol is insufficient.
negative_controls_for_producer: ready backend + valid scoped200 + local confidence refusal => connection unchanged, request remains refused
ready backend + wrong choice/schema/probabilities => do not classify healthy solely from BudgetRefusal
newer auth/network/unknown failure after older selected => no blind fallback to older selected
disabled activation/missing credential => unavailable even with old healthy route
started after prior validated connection => not itself a disconnection
review_limitation: Source and pinned response review with in-memory reproduction only; not execution of backend credential loaders or new connection validation
